choice.basis: The dashboard shows the 2020 count for Single women (red square) is physically higher than the count for Married couple (blue circle). Although the chart uses dual axes, the visible vertical position of the Single women marker is at the top of the plot, while the Married couple marker is near the bottom. Based on the visual evidence provided, the Single women group has the larger 2020 count.
